edge_case_tests.description: Verify that attempting to mutate a field on any of the four frozen dataclasses raises `FrozenInstanceError`.
preconditions: afissues package installed or on PYTHONPATH
edge_case_tests.input: construct instances of `PrResult`, `PrState`, `CheckResult`, `ReviewComment`; attempt to assign a new value to a field on each
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from afissues.protocol import PrResult, PrState, CheckResult, ReviewComment
for instance, field, val in [
    (PrResult(html_url='u', number=1), 'number', 2),
    (PrState(number=1, state='open', merged=False, head_sha='x'), 'state', 'closed'),
    (CheckResult(name='n', status='s', conclusion=None, output_title='', output_summary=''), 'name', 'x'),
    (ReviewComment(user='u', state='APPROVED', body='b', submitted_at='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'user', 'z')
]:
    with assert_raises(FrozenInstanceError):
        setattr(instance, field, val)
